scope: Existing per-vessel top1 reliability diagnosis only. No gap-localization retry, no new incident threshold, no score or candidate change.
execution_evidence: collaboration.spawn_agent returned /root/coldstart, /root/gap_formula, /root/interpretation; outputs received. These are requested configurations, not an independently measured parent-model change.

visual_review.method: Inspected 11 contact sheets containing all 88 selected original panel peak-day maps and full timelines; additionally inspected full panels 038 and 051. Exact intervals/centroid separations are calculated from parquet, not inferred from pixel positions. PDF embedded pixels matched corresponding PNG pixels for all 88.
visual_review.classification_definition: gap_end_rise means peak timestamp minus immediately preceding timestamp >1 hour, and stored peak score > immediately preceding stored score. continuous_hour means difference exactly 1 hour. This is a descriptive pattern, not an incident or artifact verdict.
observations: Long whole-period timelines can hide one-hour continuity; exact row timestamps are authoritative for the 34/54 split.
All 88 peak-day maps and timelines inspected; maps are spatial summaries, not actual continuous vessel paths.
Panels 043,044,045,067 show sparse tiny geometry and gap-end peaks, supporting caution about interpreting high s_gap as large physical displacement.
Full case1 panel038 and case2 panel051 show selected maxima; both have a valid immediately preceding hour.
limitations: Top1 selection itself induces previous-score rise and next-score fall; these are not independent causal evidence.
No incident ground truth; confirmed artifact count cannot be inferred from these pictures.
Centroid separation is not path length or speed.

interpretation: 39 is the count lacking sufficient prior rows, not a measured false-positive contamination rate.
Removing the 39 changes cohort composition; it is not score correction or evidence of improved accident detection.
Longer gap raises or preserves the time-CDF contribution at fixed distance; at 1h this CDF already equals 0.8991116049646196.
34 gap-end peaks are compatible with observation/CDF effects but cannot all be declared artifacts.

checks: All 100 candidate source ordinals, vessel IDs, timestamps, scores, past-row counts, and original peak rule agree.
88 selected IDs match; independent predecessor classification is 34 intervals>1h and 54 intervals=1h.
independent_review.interpretation_review: /root/interpretation, astra_decision requested GPT-6 Astra high; no blanket artifact/accident or left-truncation causation claim.
